name: Florian Ecker-Pfleger
title: Managing Partner, WTH Steuerberatung
quote:
Working with Moritz Lembert mattered a great deal to me, personally and professionally.
I was facing an important decision: to go my own way and buy into the firm. Moritz did not take that decision off my hands. He gave me the space to order my thoughts, to take my doubts seriously, and to find my own answers.
With his calm, appreciative, and at the same time clear manner, he encouraged me to trust my conviction and take the next step. What helped most was his ability to listen, to ask the right questions, and to bring me back again and again to what matters.
Through the coaching I gained more clarity about my goals, my role, and my own path. I am very grateful to Moritz for being alongside me in that decisive phase and helping me find the courage for this important decision.
I can recommend Moritz without reservation to anyone who wants to gain personal or professional clarity and make important decisions out of their own conviction.
highlight: Moritz did not take the decision off my hands. He gave me the space to order my thoughts, take my doubts seriously, and find my own answers.
